newsArticles.summary:
🚨BEWARE OF ROMANCE SCAMS USING DEEPFAKE TECHNOLOGY! 🚨

❤️ Not everyone you meet online is who they claim to be. Scammers may use AI-generated photos, cloned voices, and multiple fake identities to gain your trust, manipulate your emotions, and eventually steal your money.

🛡️ PROTECT YOUR HEART AND YOUR MONEY!
✅ Verify the identity of people you meet online.
✅ Be cautious of profiles with suspicious or inconsistent information.
✅ Never send money, gift cards, or financial details to online acquaintances you have never met or verified.
✅ Avoid sharing sensitive personal information and private photos.
✅ Report suspicious accounts and suspected scams to the proper authorities.

📢 Think before you trust. Verify before you act. Stay vigilant against online deception and help raise awareness about the misuse of artificial intelligence.

newsArticles.title: 🚨 BEWARE OF AUDIO SCAMS USING DEEPFAKE TECHNOLOGY! 🚨
newsArticles.summary:
🚨 BEWARE OF AUDIO SCAMS USING DEEPFAKE TECHNOLOGY! 🚨

Imagine receiving a call from someone who sounds exactly like your daughter, urgently asking for money. Would you immediately send it?

⚠️ Think before you act! Scammers can use AI-generated or cloned voices to impersonate family members and trick victims into sending money.

🛡️ Stay alert and protect yourself:
✅ Verify the caller’s identity by contacting them through another trusted number.
✅ Ask personal questions only your real family member would know.
✅ Never rush into sending money, even when the request sounds urgent.
✅ Be cautious about sharing voice recordings and personal information online.
✅ Report suspected scams to the proper authorities.

📢 Stop. Verify. Protect. A familiar voice does not always mean a trusted person is on the other end of the line.

Let us work together to raise awareness and prevent online fraud!

newsArticles.title: 🚨 PUBLIC AWARENESS: BEWARE OF DEEPFAKE CEO SCAMS! 🚨
newsArticles.summary:
🚨 PUBLIC AWARENESS: BEWARE OF DEEPFAKE CEO SCAMS! 🚨

Titay Municipal Police Station joins INTERPOL’s global public awareness campaign against deepfake scams, which use artificial intelligence (AI) to create fake videos or audio impersonating company executives and other trusted individuals.

⚠️ Think Before You Transfer! Scammers may use deepfake video calls to pressure employees into making urgent bank transfers. Do not rely solely on what you see or hear.

✅ Stay Safe Online:
🔹 Verify unusual payment requests through a separate, trusted communication channel.
🔹 Confirm bank transfer instructions with the authorized person.
🔹 Be cautious of urgent, secret, or unusual financial requests.
🔹 Never share sensitive information without proper verification.
🔹 Report suspected scams to the proper authorities.

Remember: Seeing and hearing someone online does not guarantee that they are real. Stay alert, verify first, and help prevent cybercrime!

𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒 || Shift A personnel responded to a vehicular accident at Barangay Kitabog, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay.The responding team immediately proceeded to the scene and initiated appropriate emergency response actions.
      
Upon arrival at the scene, the responding team ensured scene safety and secured the area prior to patient contact. One male patient was found seated at the roadside, conscious and oriented, with a patent airway and spontaneous respirations. Initial assessment revealed a visible laceration on the left eyebrow, abrasion on the left zygoma and lower lip and avulsion on the left metacarpal.
      Immediate first aid was rendered by applying direct pressure to the lacerations using sterile gauze to control bleeding. The affected wounds were cleansed with an appropriate irrigating solution and covered with sterile gauze dressings. The patient was continuously monitored for changes in level of consciousness, neurological status, and other signs of clinical deterioration.
       
The patient was immediately transported via BFP Ambulance to Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center, Barangay Tenan, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, for further medical evaluation, treatment, and management.

Upon arrival at the basketball court, the responding team secured the area and conducted an immediate primary assessment. The patient was found seated on a chair, conscious and oriented, complaining of pain and swelling in the affected ankle following a twisting injury.

Immediate first aid was provided by applying a cold pack for 15 minutes, securing the affected ankle with an elastic bandage, and elevating the injured extremity to help reduce swelling and discomfort. The patient remained in stable condition and was left at the scene after being advised to seek medical evaluation if the pain or swelling persisted, worsened, or if additional symptoms developed.

𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒 || Titay Municipal Fire Station (MFS) Shift A personnel promptly responded to a reported vehicular accident at Barangay Kitabog, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay, involving a female patient who sustained abrasions to the right eyebrow and left toe.

Upon arrival at the scene, the responding team secured the area and conducted an immediate primary assessment. The patient was found seated on a chair at the roadside, conscious and oriented. Further assessment revealed abrasions on the right eyebrow and left toe.

Immediate first aid was provided by cleansing the affected areas with an appropriate wound-irrigation solution, followed by the application of povidone-iodine (Betadine) to help reduce the risk of infection. The patient's condition was assessed, with a Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score of 15 recorded.

Medical transport to the nearest appropriate health facility was offered for further evaluation and treatment. However, the patient declined transport after being informed of the potential risks associated with refusing medical care. The Refusal of Transport waiver was explained, signed, and properly secured. The patient was left at the scene in stable condition and advised to seek immediate medical attention if symptoms persisted, worsened, or new symptoms developed.

Titay MFS reminds the public that even seemingly minor injuries following a vehicular accident may require medical evaluation. Prompt assessment and appropriate medical care are essential for ensuring safety and preventing possible complications.

🔥 INDUSTRIAL & HAZARDOUS MATERIALS MONTH 2026 🔥

ALAMIN. IWASAN. AGAPAN. KALIGTASAN, UNAHIN!

Sa industriya, bawat kemikal, kagamitan, at proseso ay may kaakibat na panganib. Kaya naman, **safety first bago trabaho!

🧪 TIP #1: ALAMIN ANG HAZARD!
Bago magsimula, kilalanin ang mga hazardous materials sa inyong lugar. Basahin ang labels, warning signs, at Safety Data Sheet (SDS) upang malaman ang tamang paghawak at pag-iimbak.

🔥 TIP #2: IWAS SPARK, IWAS SUNOG!
Ilayo ang apoy, spark, sigarilyo, at iba pang ignition sources sa flammable materials. Tiyaking ligtas ang lugar bago magsagawa ng welding, cutting, o grinding.

Tandaan: Isang simpleng pag-iingat ngayon ay maaaring makaiwas sa malaking sunog at pagkawala ng buhay at ari-arian. 💪🧯

Ligtas na trabaho, ligtas na komunidad!
Para sa fire safety concerns, makipag-ugnayan sa **Titay Municipal Fire Station.**

newsArticles.title: BFP Titay Conducts Fire Square Roadshow for Titay District Student Leaders
newsArticles.summary:
BFP Titay Conducts Fire Square Roadshow for Titay District Student Leaders

TITAY, Zamboanga Sibugay — September 12, 2026 — More than just classroom lessons, fire safety education came alive as the Titay Municipal Fire Station (MFS) conducted a Fire Square Roadshow for student leaders of the Titay District at Titay National High School, Poblacion, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay. The activity equipped young leaders with essential knowledge and practical skills in fire prevention, basic firefighting, rescue, first aid, and Exit Drill in the Home (EDITH), empowering them to become active advocates of safety and preparedness in their schools, homes, and communities.

The activity aimed to strengthen the knowledge, skills, and preparedness of student leaders in preventing and responding to fire and other emergencies. It provided participants with practical lessons and demonstrations on basic firefighting, rescue techniques, first aid, and Exit Drill in the Home (EDITH).

Adding an interactive approach to fire safety education, BFP Titay also facilitated online fire safety games, allowing participants to test and reinforce their knowledge through engaging and interactive activities.

The Fire Square Roadshow emphasized the important role of students as fire safety advocates and responsible members of the community. By equipping young leaders with essential fire safety knowledge and emergency response skills, the BFP seeks to help build a culture of preparedness and strengthen community resilience.

At this magnitude, no damage and aftershocks are expected.

Although this was a minor earthquake, it serves as a reminder that our municipality should always be prepared for any emergency.

🔹 Safety Reminders:
✅ Stay calm and avoid spreading unverified information.
✅ Familiarize yourself with safe evacuation areas and emergency exits.
✅ Prepare and maintain your emergency go bag.
✅ During strong earthquakes, remember: DROP, COVER, and HOLD ON.
✅ Follow only official updates from PHIVOLCS and LDRRMO-Titay.

Let us remain vigilant and always practice disaster preparedness. Being prepared today can save lives tomorrow.
